statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Continuous mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered to detect arrhythmic events and guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate-control management.
The diagnoses are I49.5 and I48.0.
The denial reason code is CO-197.
The denial is based on failure to obtain required precertification or authorization prior to the service date.
